submissions.repair-original-dispatch-index-ties:
def solve(data):
    slips = [
        slip for slip in data['slips']
        if slip['state'] == 'ready' and data['start'] <= slip['due'] <= data['end']
    ]
    slips.sort(key=lambda slip: slip['due'])
    offset = data['offset']
    return [slip['label'] for slip in slips[offset:offset + data['limit']]]
